scope: One conditional reused-history OFR Funding incremental information screen on saved 0bp Tiered local recovery amount labels: two fixed Ridge fits, one paired bootstrap, zero new native accounts

design_checks.source_timing: Only post-2017 OFR Funding observations at least three actual Qlib sessions old enter the 2018-2022 10:32 recovery screen. The source map keeps 2018/2023 documented pre-revision Funding values until the following trading session after posting, and leaves four affected 2026 held dates unknown.
design_checks.source_boundary: The official current CSV, 2023 revision workbook and 2017 launch record do not certify historical individual daily first receipt or finality. Current-method pre-2017 backfill is excluded.
design_checks.matched_receiver: The same eligible mature local net-advantage amount rows, original 21 recovery features, imputer, scaler and Ridge alpha 1 are used in both arms; the candidate adds exactly one Funding coordinate. The saved label is a 0bp added-slippage Tiered beta0.6 same-state recovery-versus-HOLD training reference, not a 2023+ full account.
design_checks.novelty: OFR systemic Funding stress is a source and mechanism distinct from the closed HYG-minus-LQD traded-credit momentum, SOXX signed-volume pressure and first-hour peer-breadth routes.
design_checks.gate: Negative added standardized coefficient, positive full and each-2021/2022 paired MSE improvement, and positive one-sided stationary full-calendar lower bound using mean block 63, 10000 draws, seed 20261023 and alpha 0.025/33.
design_checks.budget: The saved no-load artifact-path failure consumed no source objects or DatasetH. The frozen plan allows one no-fit preflight and one fresh-kernel reconstruction, cumulative four source Recorder loads and two DatasetH builds before fitting; the fit cell blocks a direct rerun before state write or Recorder creation. Exactly two fit attempts and one bootstrap are authorized.

scientific_boundary: This is conditional retrospective information on reused 2018-2022 OOF training-reference labels. A pass cannot establish historically final OFR values, a 2023+ original Stage1 own-state funded 0bp account, independent forward evidence or SOXX fee-net promotion.
